meta.bt: Tested out of sample (2021 to 2026, each season judged only on trends from the seasons before it): every side with a spot covering 5+ points above what its closing price implied (55%+ at -110) on 50+ games went 976-956 (50.5%, -3.8% return) against the closing line; 8+ points (58%+) on 100+ games, 196-215 (47.7%, -9.1% return); the first line alone, 739-723 (50.5%, -3.4% return). Totals the same way: 487-442 (52.4%, -0.1% return). Graded at each game's closing price: these trends have not beaten the closing line on games they never saw. Context, not a pick.
meta.bt_short: Out of sample (2021 to 2026, trends from earlier seasons only): sides whose spot ran 55%+ (5+ points over the price) on 50+ games went 976-956 (50.5%, -3.8% return), lost against the closing line.
meta.bt_held: None of the 41 spots the rule bet made money in 3+ later seasons with p < .05.
